name: Cove
description: A deep circular scoop taken out of every block, the cove shifting to the opposite side on alternate rows.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); overflow: hidden; :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -55%; top: -55%; width: 120%; height: 120%; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color0); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@y % 2 == 1) { :after { left: 35%; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
